blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines–Alex Eala earned a first-round bye at the Singapore Tennis Open. The Filipino sensation is seeded third in the newly upgraded WTA 500 tournament. The top four seeds in the hard-court event drew byes. Eala, the sport’s hottest draw, was initially projected to be the sixth seed in Singapore before fellow stars Jessica Pegula, Diana Shnaider and Sorana Cirstea pulled out.
